notes:
The expenses table is now the other way round: the days of the cycle run down the rows and the expense names run across the top, with a day total on the right and a column of totals along the bottom. Only the expenses that carry money get a column.

The hatchery dropdown in the sidebar now shows how many cycles each hatchery holds, so it is clear that every hatchery keeps its own cycles, and the rename button uses a pencil.
